text:
Situation: Insulin glargine is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 94 syringes (7.4 days at 12.6/day). Corvale Lakeside holds 70 syringes (26.5 days at 2.6/day). Corvale General holds 172 syringes (14.1 days). The product label (SPL set 99ea856d) lists Genzyme Corporation (FEI 3009389940) for labeling and packing, last inspected NAI on 2025-08-14, and Sanofi-Aventis Deutschland GmbH (FEI 3003195501) for analysis, labeling, manufacture, and packing, last inspected VAI on 2022-03-25.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection records for Sanofi-Aventis Deutschland GmbH show an OAI classification on 2010-09-16 (known 2010-12-15) and a Warning Letter on 2011-02-08, with subsequent inspections all VAI through 2022-03-25. Genzyme Corporation was last inspected NAI on 2025-08-14. The drug is not on FDA's shortage list.

Our position: Supply at Corvale East is below target. Corvale Lakeside and Corvale General have sufficient stock to support a transfer. No FDA shortage listing exists to trigger allocation programs. Alternative manufacturers are not on the shortage list and their labels name no plants we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 33 syringes of 1.5 mL from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval (transfer request).
2. Transfer 1 syringe of 1.5 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval (transfer request).

Not recommended: Purchasing from Biocon Biologics Inc., Civica, Inc., or Lanexa Biologics, LLC at this time.
